units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 20b:11">B. Kam. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>משום ש׳ דאשייתא</he> because the walls get black (when people live in the house).

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 117b:4">B. Mets. 117ᵇ</cite> <he>משום דאיכא ש׳</he> (Ms. H. <he>שְׁחַרְתָּא דאשיתא</he>; differ. in Ms. M., v. <cite ref="U00706"><he>שְׁחַר</he> II</cite>) because there is a claim in the case for the blackening of the walls.
